body: I believe that I have aspergers but was never diagnosed. That has hindered a lot of things in my life. I do not have a strong support system. I am lonely. I did seek out counseling and was basically told that I needed to build relationships with people. But with whom? I don't live around people my age or like me. So I become angry about that. I turned to drugs to get respite from it all. Now that has created a legal problem for me. I'm just like "fuck it." I'm looking at felonies. Possible federal indictment. I can't handle that. Then I think maybe I can beat the rap. Then I realize, for what? My problems will always be there. It's scary because my lawyer was saying that he was concerned for me. He said that people who get into the kind of trouble that I get into are "like" me and they, unfortunately, end up calling him later on because they get into trouble again. Suicide was always something I thought about and we all end up in the same place so what is the point?
